title: Lining came off while cooking in over
text: Lining came off while cooking in over. I was using the baking sheet to cook some vinegar/soy chicken on low heat (250F) and within the hour it took to slow cook my chicken the granite patterned lining was already peeling off. It was my first time to use the baking sheet so I was very surprised. I have loved the stovetop pans but now I am noticing that the granite lining is staining for some reason. I am most likely going to trash the entire set and buy a different brand, I am worried about more of the pans losing their lining and contaminating my food.
